ci_support_linux_64_c_compiler_version14:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cuda_compiler:
- cuda-nvcc
cuda_compiler_version:
- '12.9'
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
microarch_level:
- '1'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
pytorch:
- '2.14'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - c_stdlib_version
  - cuda_compiler_version
name: deepspeed
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: deepspeed
  version: "0.19.9"
  build_number: 2
  torch_proc_type: ${{ "cuda" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}
  build_string_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e14b514e243a92ad80bd92f74c835ef76a5c27eec23fae019807458fc9a8cb95
  patches:
    # Let DS_CPU_ARCH / DS_SIMD_WIDTH override build-machine detection
    # (-march=native) so pre-compiled CPU ops are portable, and pass link
    # flags (-fopenmp, -laio) when pre-compiling CPU ops.
    - patches/0001-Make-pre-compiled-CPU-ops-portable-and-fully-linked.patch
    # nvcc rejects redeclaring a template parameter as a local; rename the
    # local, keeping the semantics nvcc 12 compiled (unlike deepspeedai/DeepSpeed#8808)
    - patches/0002-fp_quantizer-do-not-redeclare-template-parameter.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ build_string_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win
    - osx and x86_64
  variant:
    # Prefer the higher x86_64 microarch levels when the CPU supports them
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 4 - (microarch_level | default(1) | int) if x86_64 else 0 }}
    use_keys:
      - CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # Sets -march=x86-64-v<level> and run-exports the __archspec guard
    - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
      then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ninja
        - cuda-profiler-api
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
    # Use {{ pytorch }} for the global pinning
    - pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* [build=${{ torch_proc_type }}*]
    # For the `async_io` op
    - if: linux
      then: libaio
    # OpenMP runtime for the CPU ops built with -fopenmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-profiler-api
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
        # For the `gds` op
        - libcufile-dev
  run:
    - einops
    - hjson-py
    - msgpack-python
    - numpy
    - packaging >=20.0
    - psutil
    - py-cpuinfo
    - pydantic >=2.0.0
    - python
    - pytorch >=2.0.0 [build=${{ torch_proc_type }}*]
    - tqdm
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - nvidia-ml-py

tests:
  # No compiler here: ops must load from the pre-compiled extensions
  - requirements:
      run:
        - ninja
        - pip
    files:
      recipe:
        - test_ops.py
    script:
      - ${CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR} python test_ops.py ${{ torch_proc_type }}
      - ${CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR} python -m pip check
  - requirements:
      run:
        - ninja
    script:
      - ${CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR} ds_report
      - ${CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR} deepspeed --help

about:
  homepage: http://deepspeed.ai
  repository: https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed
  summary: DeepSpeed library
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - loadams
    - weiji14
    - sdvillal
